Rashi on Chullin 48a:10:1.english: Which is not a membrane - But the sealing of the chest wall is a proper seal.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:11:1.hebrew: מתקיף כו' - השתא דאמרת נקב הוא בריאה, אלא שהדופן סותמתו — אילו אינקיב דופן להדה ריאה, כנגד דופן הריאה, לאחר זמן, מאי? טרפה, דאזלא לה סתימת דופן:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:11:1.english: [Rav Ukva bar Ḥama] objects, etc. - Now that you say [that there is] a perforation in the lung, but the [chest] wall seals it — if the [chest] wall opposite this lung, corresponding to the wall of the lung, were perforated at a later time, what [would the halakha be]? [It would be] a tereifa, for the sealing of the [chest] wall is gone.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:11:2.hebrew: ליתני - במתניתין נקובת הדופן בהדי שאר טרפות, דיש בהמה שנטרפה בכך:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:11:2.english: Let [the Mishnah] teach - In the Mishnah, "a perforated chest wall" along with the other tereifot, for there is an animal that is rendered a tereifa through this.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:13:1.english: That it is not through it that [the animal] is rendered a tereifa - For [the status of] tereifa comes on account of the lung.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:14:1.english: Cysts - [This is an Old French word meaning] pustules [or blisters].

Rashi on Chullin 48a:15:2.english: Doesn’t the Master desire a piece of meat? - He wanted to know whether he would declare it kosher or not.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:15:3.english: I have no money - He was putting him off.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:15:4.hebrew: אקפן אנא - הטבחים יקיפו לי באמנה, כמו "החנווני מקיף" — לשון אמנה:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:15:4.english: I will buy on credit - The butchers will give me credit on trust, like "The shopkeeper gives credit" — an expression of trust.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:15:5.hebrew: וליה לא סבירא ליה - לרבי יוחנן לא סבירא ליה לאכשורי, ומיטרף נמי לא הוה טריף לה ניהלייהו, דלא שמיעא ליה מרביה:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:15:5.english: And he did not hold [accordingly] - Rabbi Yoḥanan did not hold [that one should] declare [it] kosher, but neither would he declare it a tereifah for them, as he had not heard [a tradition] from his teacher.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:16:1.english: We would walk - [That is,] we were walking. Masgei is an expression of stepping.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:1:1.hebrew: שלפוחית - קרום שהולד מונח בה, ובלע"ז מרי"ץ. לקמן בפירקין (חולין דף נה:) תניא: היא האם, היא טרפחת, היא שלפוחית:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:1:1.english: Womb - The membrane in which the fetus lies, and in Old French, matriz [uterus]. Later in our chapter (Chullin 55b), it is taught: It is the em [womb], it is the tarpaḥat, it is the shalpuḥit.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:1:2.hebrew: ואסרו להם - לא גרסינן. ובשני הרגלים לא אמרו להם כלום, ובשלישי עמדו למנין, ורבו המתירין והתירוהו:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:1:2.english: And they forbade [it] to them - We do not read [this in the text]. And on the [first] two pilgrimage festivals they did not say anything to them, and on the third [festival] they took a vote, and those who permitted [it] were in the majority, and they permitted it.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:2:1.english: Adjacent to the [chest] wall - Attached to the ribs.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:2:2.hebrew: אין חוששין לה - שמא ניקבה, אלא תלינן ריעותא בדופן, ואמרינן: דופן זה מכה היתה בו, וכשחיתה קלטה הריאה אצלה:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:2:2.english: One need not be concerned about it - that perhaps it was perforated; rather, we attribute the defect to the [chest] wall, and we say: This wall had a wound in it, and when it healed, it attached the lung to itself.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:2:3.english: [If] it sprouted - The lung [sprouted them].

Rashi on Chullin 48a:2:4.hebrew: צמחין - מנל"ץ, סביבות סמיכתה לדופן. הואיל וחזינן בה ריעותא, תלינן למכה בדידה:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:2:4.english: Cysts - [Manelz, Old French for pustules,] around [the area of] its attachment to the chest wall. Since we see a flaw in it, we attribute the wound to [the lung] itself.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:3:1.hebrew: דחליש פומיה - פיו חדוד ודק, וחותך יפה, שלא יקרע קרום הריאה במושכו אותה מן הדופן:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:3:1.english: Whose edge is thin - Its edge is sharp and thin and cuts well, so that the membrane of the lung will not tear as he pulls it from the chest wall.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:4:1.hebrew: בדיק לה בפשורי - לאחר שפירקוה ומצאו מכה בדופן, מנפח בה. אי מבצבצא מיא — טרפה, שהרי ניקבה:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:4:1.english: He examined it in tepid water - After they separated it and found a wound on the [chest] wall, he would inflate it. If the water bubbles, [the animal is] a tereifa, for it was perforated.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:5:1.hebrew: ה"ג בשלמא הכא תלינן בדופן וכשרה, ולא גרסינן אי איכא ריעותא בדופן - כלומר, בשלמא הכא בדיק לה, דאי לא מבצבצא לא אמרינן ניקבה ונסתמה, דכיון דאיכא למיתלייה בדופן תלינן בה, וכשרה:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:5:1.english: This is the correct reading: "Granted, here we attribute [it] to the [chest] wall and [it is] kosher," and we do not read: "If there is a defect in the [chest] wall" - That is to say: Granted, here he examines it, for if [air] does not bubble out, we do not say [that the lung] was perforated and became sealed; for since it is possible to attribute [the adhesion] to the [chest] wall, we attribute [it] to it, and [the animal is] kosher.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:5:2.hebrew: אלא הכא - גבי תרתי אוני — מכדי סרכא זו מחמת מכה היתה, הי מינייהו דאנקיב טרפה; והאי דלא מפקא זיקא — קרום עלה בה וסתמה:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:5:2.english: Rather, here - Regarding two lobes: After all, this adhesion arose from a wound; whichever of them was perforated, [the animal is] a tereifa. And as for this [fact] that it does not emit air — a membrane grew over it and sealed it.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:6:1.hebrew: ומי אמר ר"נ הכי - דהעלתה צמחין חוששין לה — מכלל דאי פשיטא לן דניקבה הריאה, לא מהני לה סתימת הדופן:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:6:1.english: And did Rav Naḥman say this? - [Namely,] that [if] it developed cysts we are concerned about it — by implication, if it were clear to us that the lung was perforated, the sealing of the [chest] wall would not be effective for it.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:6:2.hebrew: התם במקום רביתא - במקום שהריאה והדופן גדלין כאחד וסמוכין תמיד, דלא מיפרק ההיא סירכא, הילכך כשרה. וכי אמר ר"נ "חוששין לה" — למעלה, ברוחב החלל, כנגד האומא הגדולה, דכיון דרחוקה הריאה מן הדופן, מיפרקא ההיא סתימה. ואפילו הכי, כי לא העלתה צמחים, אמר "אין חוששין לה", דתלי לה בדופן. ובהא, כאבימי סבירא לן דחוששין לה, ולחומרא אזלינן בדאורייתא:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:6:2.english: There, in the place of growth - In a place where the lung and the chest wall grow together and are always adjacent, so that that adhesion does not detach; therefore, [the animal] is kosher. And when Rav Naḥman said, "[One must be] concerned about it," [he was referring to an adhesion found] higher up, in the width of the [chest] cavity opposite the large lobe, for since the lung is distant from the chest wall, that seal will detach. And even so, when it did not develop cysts, he said, "One does not need to be concerned about it," because we attribute [the adhesion] to the chest wall. And regarding this, we hold in accordance with Avimi that one must be concerned about it, and we follow the stringent view in matters of Torah law.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:7:1.hebrew: מקום חיתוכי דאוני - שהן סמוך לצואר, במיצר החלל. ובהא הילכתא כרב נחמן, דליכא דפליג עליה:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:7:1.english: The area of the sectioning of the lobes - Which are near the neck, in the narrow part of the [chest] cavity. And in this [matter], the halakha is in accordance with Rav Naḥman, as there is no one who disagrees with him.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:8:1.hebrew: דסביך בבישרא - שנסבכת ונאחזת הריאה בבשר שבין ב' הצלעות, דהוי סתימה שרירא דלא מיפרקא. אבל בצלעות עצמן, אין זו סירכא קיימת:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:8:1.english: That it is tangled in the flesh - That the lung is entangled and attached to the flesh between the two ribs, as it is a firm seal that does not come detached. But to the ribs themselves, this is not an enduring adhesion.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:8:2.hebrew: אלמא נקב הוא - ואפילו הכי, כי סביך מכשרת לה — אלמא דמהניא סתימה לריאה שנקבה:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:8:2.english: Evidently it is a perforation - And nevertheless, when it is tangled [in the flesh], you declare it kosher; evidently, sealing is effective for a lung that was perforated.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:9:1.english: [If] it was perforated - The male organ of a person.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:9:2.english: Unfit - On account of [the prohibition of] a kerut shofkhah [one with a severed member].

Rashi on Chullin 48a:9:3.hebrew: מפני שהוא שותת - ואינו יורה כחץ, וקי"ל (נדה דף מג.): כל שכבת זרע שאינו יורה כחץ, אינו מוליד:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:9:3.english: Because it discharges gently - And does not shoot forth like an arrow; and we maintain (Niddah 43a): Any semen that does not shoot forth like an arrow does not fertilize.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:9:4.english: [If] it was sealed - The perforation [was sealed] afterwards.

Rashi on Chullin 48a:9:5.hebrew: כשר - לבא בקהל, מפני שהוא מוליד:
Rashi on Chullin 48a:9:5.english: Fit - To enter into the assembly, because he can procreate.

Tosafot on Chullin 48a:10:1.hebrew: לא למעוטי קרום שעלה מחמת מכה בריאה - ה"נ הוה מצי למימר: למעוטי שלא במקום רביתייהו:
Tosafot on Chullin 48a:10:1.english: No, to exclude a membrane that appeared due to a wound in the lung - [The Gemara] could also have said: To exclude [an adhesion that is] not in their natural place [of growth].

Tosafot on Chullin 48a:14:1.hebrew: העלתה צמחין מהו אמר ליה כשרה - והא דאמר לעיל דחוששין לה — היינו בסרוכה לדופן, דמוכחא מילתא שהסירכא מחמת נקב:
Tosafot on Chullin 48a:14:1.english: "If it grew cysts, what is [the halakha]? He said to him: [It is] kosher" - And that which [the Gemara] said above, that we are concerned for it — that is [specifically when the lung is] attached to the chest wall, for the matter proves that the adhesion [arose] due to a perforation.

Tosafot on Chullin 48a:1:1.hebrew: שלפוחית - היינו במקום שהולד מונח. אבל ניקב כיס השתן או ניטל — טרפה. ומה שלא הוזכר, לא במשנה ולא בגמרא — שמא הוי בכלל "ניקבו הדקין":
Tosafot on Chullin 48a:1:1.english: Shelpoḥit - That is the place where the fetus lies. But if the urinary bladder was perforated or removed, [the animal is] a tereifah. And as for [the fact] that it was mentioned neither in the Mishnah nor in the Gemara — perhaps it is included under [the category of] "the intestines were perforated."

Tosafot on Chullin 48a:3:1.hebrew: מייתינן סכינא דחליש פומיה - דהיינו כשלא העלתה צמחים, אבל העלתה צמחים — אפילו איכא ריעותא בדופן, לא תלינן בדופן:
Tosafot on Chullin 48a:3:1.english: "We bring a knife whose edge is thin" - That is, when [the lung] did not develop growths; but if it developed growths, even if there is a defect in the chest wall, we do not attribute [the attachment] to the chest wall.

Tosafot on Chullin 48a:4:1.hebrew: רב נחמיה בריה דרב יוסף בדיק לה בפשורי - אאיכא ריעותא בדופן קאי, כדפירש בקונטרס. ועתה נוהגין להטריף כל הסירכות, ואין בודקין אותן — לא בדופן ולא בפשורי:
Tosafot on Chullin 48a:4:1.english: Rav Neḥemya, son of Rav Yosef, examined it in tepid water - [This statement] applies to [a case where] there is an irregularity on the chest wall, as explained in the Kuntres [Rashi]. And nowadays, it is customary to declare all adhesions tereifah, and they are not inspected — neither at the chest wall nor in tepid water.

Tosafot on Chullin 48a:8:1.hebrew: אמר רבינא והוא דסביך בבשרא - פירוש: נאחז ומסובך היטב בבשר, כמו צמר מסובך, ולהכי נקט סביך ולא נקט סריך. ובתשובת רב שר שלום גאון כתב: דבין סריך וסביך, ובין לא סביך וסריך — כשרה; ולית הלכתא כרבינא, אלא כרב נחמן, דאמר: "ריאה שניקבה ודופן סותמתה כשרה". ומשמע מתוך דבריו, דרבינא לא בא לפרש דבריו של רב נחמן, אלא סברא דנפשיה קאמר. וכן נראה, מדפריך עליה ד"העלתה צמחים חוששין לה": "ומי אמר רב נחמן הכי? והאמר רב נחמן: ריאה שניקבה ודופן סותמתה כשרה!", ולא משני: "הא דסביך, הא דלא סביך". ועוד, מדפריך רב יוסף לרבינא ולא לרב נחמן, משמע דלרב נחמן לא בעי לא סביך ולא סריך, ואין נקב פוסל שם, שדופן סותמתו. ומיהו, לא ידעינן מנא ליה שלא יהא הלכה כרבינא, שהוא בתרא? ושמא אין זה רבינא סתמא שהוא בכל הש"ס, שהיה חבירו של רב אשי, שנולד ביום שמת רבא, מדבא רב יוסף להשיב על דבריו. ובהלכות טרפות של רבינו גרשום כתב, דריאה הסמוכה לדופן, אף במקום רביתייהו דאוני, וסרוכה וסבוכה בבשר שבין הצלעות או בצלעות עצמן — בדקינא להו בנפיחה עם הצלעות, או גוררין הבשר עם הסירכא ומנפחין לה; אם עולה בנפיחה — כשרה, דכיוון שהסירכא קיימת וסותמת כל הנקב, לא יתפרק עוד, כיון דבמקום רביתייהו קיימא. ובקונטרס פירש: דסביך בבשרא היינו דוקא בבשר שבין הצלעות, אבל בצלעות עצמן — לא:
Tosafot on Chullin 48a:8:1.english: Ravina said: And this is [only] when it is tangled in the flesh - Explanation: It is attached and thoroughly entangled in the flesh, like tangled wool; and for this reason he used the term savikh [entangled] and did not use sarikh [adhered]. And in a responsum of Rav Sar Shalom Gaon he wrote: that whether [the lung] is adhered and entangled, or whether it is not entangled but adhered, it is kosher; and the halakha is not in accordance with Ravina, but rather in accordance with Rav Naḥman, who said: "If a lung was perforated and the chest wall seals it, it is kosher." And it is implied from his words that Ravina did not come to explain the words of Rav Naḥman, but rather stated his own reasoning. And so it appears from [the fact] that [the Gemara] raised an objection against [the statement], "If it grew blisters, we are concerned for it": "And did Rav Naḥman [really] say this? But didn't Rav Naḥman say: If a lung was perforated and the chest wall seals it, it is kosher!" — and it did not resolve [the contradiction by answering]: "This is where it is entangled, and that is where it is not entangled." And furthermore, from [the fact] that Rav Yosef raised an objection against Ravina and not against Rav Naḥman, it implies that according to Rav Naḥman, [the lung] requires neither savikh nor sarikh, and a perforation does not invalidate there because the chest wall seals it. However, we do not know from where he [Rav Sar Shalom Gaon] derived that the halakha would not be in accordance with Ravina, who is a later authority [batra]? And perhaps this is not the unqualified Ravina who appears throughout the Talmud, who was the colleague of Rav Ashi [and] who was born on the day that Rava died, since Rav Yosef came to reply to his words. And in Hilkhot Tereifot of Rabbeinu Gershom he wrote: that with a lung adjacent to the chest wall, even in the natural place of growth of the lobes, and it is adhered and entangled in the flesh between the ribs or to the ribs themselves — we examine them by inflation together with the ribs, or we scrape off the flesh with the adhesion and inflate it; if it holds the inflation, it is kosher, because since the adhesion remains intact and seals the entire perforation, it will not detach anymore, since it stands in its natural place of growth. And in the Kunteres he explained that "entangled in the flesh" means specifically in the flesh between the ribs, but to the ribs themselves, no.
